question: The ammonium ion released in the muscle is exported to the liver in the form of:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Branched amino acids -> undergo transamination -> form glutamate -> glutamate converted to α-ketoglutarate -> α-ketoglutarate enters the urea cycle -> ammonium ion released -> exported to the liver -> 95%
CHAIN: Glutamate -> undergoes deamination -> forms ammonium ion -> exported to the liver -> 90%
analysis: When ammonium ions are released in the muscle, they are transported to the liver in the form of glutamate through the process of the urea cycle.
